# Research queue (DA_PR_queue.1): start the queued node as its Start button would; else tell the player (DA_PR_queue.2).
DA_PR_start_queued = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 1 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } }	# Arcane Energy
		if = {
			limit = { always = yes }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				hidden_trigger = {
					always = no
				}
			}

			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 1 } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
		if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } }	# Steam Power
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Steam_Power_Project = yes } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { DA_completed.Steam_Power_Project = yes } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_2 = yes
				DA_completed.Mechanics_2 = yes
				DA_completed.Alchemy_2 = yes
				DA_yet_to_complete.Steam_Power_Project = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = steam
				time = 120
				steam = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				country_event = {
					id = DA_project_event.300
					days = 30
				}
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		} }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 0 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 2 } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
		if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 3 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } }	# Electric Power
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Electric_Power_Project = yes } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { DA_completed.Electric_Power_Project = yes } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_3 = yes
				DA_completed.Mechanics_3 = yes
				DA_completed.Alchemy_3 = yes
				DA_completed.Steam_Power_Project = yes
				DA_yet_to_complete.Electric_Power_Project = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = electric
				time = 180
				electric = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				country_event = {
					id = DA_project_event.310
					days = 30
				}
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		} }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 0 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 3 } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
		if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 4 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } }	# Transcendent Technology
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_has_transcendent_path_to_unlock = yes } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { NOT = { DA_has_transcendent_path_to_unlock = yes } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Electric_Power_Project = yes
				DA_has_transcendent_path_to_unlock = yes
			}
			# Mega Engineering: see "Claude files/tools/build_mega_engineering.py"
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = trascendence
				time = 240
				electric = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		} }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 0 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 4 } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
		if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 5 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } }	# Fire Magic
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes
				DA_yet_to_complete.Elemental_Magic_Fire = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = fire
				time = 36
				arcane = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		} }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 0 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 5 } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
		if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 6 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } }	# Water Magic
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes
				DA_yet_to_complete.Elemental_Magic_Water = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = water
				time = 36
				arcane = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		} }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 0 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 6 } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
		if = {
		limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 7 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } }	# Earth Magic
		if = {
			limit = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Earth = yes } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# finished meanwhile
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { DA_completed.Elemental_Magic_Earth = yes } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = {
				DA_available_research = yes
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_1 = yes
				DA_yet_to_complete.Elemental_Magic_Earth = yes
			}
			DA_start_research = {
				flag = earth
				time = 36
				arcane = yes
				unstoppable = yes
			}
			set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
		} }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_2 value = 0 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_PR_start_queued_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 7 } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
		if = {

# A change of race (build_racial_heritage.py): the research of the former race's page stops and keeps its
# progress, which DA_start_research gives back (DA_PR_restore_paused) if the same research starts again.
DA_PR_pause_page_unique = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.Runic_barrier }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_Runic_barrier which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.Runic_barrier_2 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_Runic_barrier_2 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.Runic_barrier_3 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_Runic_barrier_3 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.Runic_barrier_4 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_Runic_barrier_4 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.runes_manufacturing }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_runes_manufacturing which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes

		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Gen3 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Gen3 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Sto1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Sto1 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Sto2 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Sto2 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Sto3 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Sto3 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Gol1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Gol1 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Gol2 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Gol2 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Gol3 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Gol3 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Chr1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Chr1 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Chr2 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Chr2 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Chr3 }

	if = {

		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Mag1 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Mag2 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Mag2 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Mag3 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Mag3 which = DA_research_progress }
		DA_reset_research = yes

	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_research_flag.PR_LZ_Ars1 }

		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_PR_LZ_Lon1 which = DA_research_progress }

	if = {

	}
}
DA_PR_restore_paused = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_$flag$ value = 0.001 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_research_progress which = DA_PR_paused_$flag$ }
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_paused_$flag$ value = 0 }
	}
}
